Asset Hoard v0.1.5 Release Notes

Fonts, Unity packages, and navigation history

This release adds support for fonts and Unity packages, a new move-to-bundle picker, back/forward navigation, bundle cover cropping, and a handful of quality-of-life improvements across imports and watched folders.

✨ New File Types

  • Font support — .ttf, .otf, .woff, and other font files are now supported with thumbnails and previews
  • Unity package import — Improved .unitypackage support, complete with thumbnail extraction and version tracking per bundle

🚀 Features

  • Move to Bundle — Relocate assets and bundles with a new modal featuring a fuzzy-searchable bundle tree picker, accessible from the right-click context menu
  • Navigation history — Browse back and forward through your navigation history using Alt+Left / Alt+Right or mouse4 / mouse5
  • Cover cropping — Pick and crop images for your bundle covers with the new cover crop picker
  • Remove orphaned assets — Audit your library for assets with broken file links and clean them up in one click
  • Unity package directories — Manage Unity package directories from a dedicated settings panel

📂 Watched Folders

  • Play/pause watchers — Pause and resume individual watched folder watchers
  • Smarter imports — Shared import logic with improved thumbnail generation
  • Better progress tracking — Improved debounce and progress handling during file watching
  • Cleaner notifications — Less noisy, more useful notifications for watched folder events

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Undo/redo counts — Undo and redo now correctly update bundle cumulative counts after restoring items
  • SVG & text handling — Improved metadata extraction and error handling for SVG and plain text files
  • "New" badges — Badges can now be cleared after watched folder import
  • Thumbnail errors — Better error handling when thumbnail generation fails

🔧 Improvements

  • Sidebar tag refresh — Importing assets now updates the sidebar tag filters to reflect newly created tags
  • Material thumbnails — Improved thumbnail generation for material assets

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding!

Asset Hoard v0.1.4 Release Notes

Performance improvements and preview modal

This release brings major performance gains, a unified sorting system, and improvements to 3D model previews.

✨ Features

  • Large preview — dbl-click on an asset to see a large preview panel
  • Plain text content detection — Auto detect plaintext for non-supported files to show contents
  • Code detection for web assets — HTML, CSS, Svelete, and others now supported
  • Asset dimensions display — Show dimensions in the preview panel
  • Optimised asset import — Re-importing assets updates them in place rather than reloading from scratch
  • Unified sorting system — Sorting with tag support, plus optimised bundle detail stats retrieval
  • Linux update notification — Shows a "download here" link when a new version is released

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Emissive texture support — Emissive textures are now loaded and rendered correctly
  • Code preview fills modal — Preview now properly fills the modal area
  • Blender files on Linux — Fixed Blender rendering on Linux
  • Sidebar bundle counts — Counts now update correctly on delete or redo
  • Refresh filestat — Refresh now re-stats files to catch missing or restored files

🔧 Improvements

  • Model centering/camera — Improved model centering and camera positioning in preview
  • Ignore dotfiles — Now ignores all dotfiles (.DS_Store, .gitkeep, etc.) during folder imports (can still be imported directly)
  • Clickable Directories — in settings in the watched directories and unity sections
  • Simplified Bundling — assets can no longer exist in multiple bundles to simplify navigation
  • Thumbnail sharding — Optimised thumbnail storage to mitigate older file system types

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding!

Asset Hoard v0.1.6 Release Notes

Faster startup, and runtime optimisations

This release improves speeds up startup with lazy loading, 3D thumbnail generation, search, and import scanning. As well as more resiliancy for several filetypes like gltf, gif, mat and others.

🚀 Performance

  • Faster startup — App boot time is significantly faster thanks to lazy loading of heavy libraries
  • Non-blocking 3D thumbnails — 3D thumbnail generation now faster async
  • Thumbnail timeout — Thumbnail generation now has a timeout to prevent the app from hanging
  • Watched Folder — Scanning on start up massively optimised, we now scan for differences first and import the delta

🔍 Search & Navigation

  • Smarter search — Empty queries are now skipped, and bundle filters update based on search scope
  • Smoother loading states — Search results show a cleaner loading experience
  • Navigation history — Improved consistency between the UI back button and mouse back button
  • Search input fix — Fixed a reactive loop that could cause search input to behave unexpectedly

📂 Import & Scanning

  • Artifact filtering — Temporary and system files (like ~$ prefixed files) are now automatically skipped during import scans
  • Improved folder scanning — Better scan event handling for more reliable folder imports

🎨 Previews

  • Audio autoplay — Audio files now autoplay when opened in expanded preview mode
  • Bundle cover thumbnails — Thumbnail generation now works for assets used in bundle covers

🔧 Other Improvements & Bug Fixes

  • Startup diagnostics — Library stats are logged during startup for easier troubleshooting in debug mode
  • Debug mode — New logging throughout the app for performance diagnostics
  • Discord link — Added a Discord icon to the About section in settings
  • Material files — Binary .mat files are now detected with metadata automatically extracted
  • Unity Packages — now import into the correct bundle rather than importing unbundled.

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding!
